Implement the following requested change in the repository.

UL4Lexer doesn't handle nested note and doc tags correctly

Description

When using the UL4Lexer with nested note or doc tags, the lexer doesn't properly handle the nesting structure. This causes issues when trying to highlight UL4 code that contains nested documentation or comment blocks.

For example, if you have a UL4 template with nested note tags like:

```
<?note?>
  Some comment
  <?note?>
    Nested comment
  <?end note?>
  More comment
<?end note?>
```

The lexer fails to properly process this structure. Similarly, nested doc tags also don't work correctly:

```
<?doc?>
  Documentation
  <?doc?>
    Nested documentation
  <?end doc?>
  More documentation
<?end doc?>
```

I tried to use this in a template and got an error when the lexer tried to process it. The lexer seems to be missing the ability to handle these nested structures properly.

To reproduce the issue, try to use the UL4Lexer on a file containing nested note or doc tags as shown in the examples above.

Scope of this editing session: update the following production files and report the resulting local change for handover: pygments/lexers/ul4.py. No full task validation has been performed in this session.
